Key results included a total of 46 megawatt hours of energy was dispensed through the EV charging stations.
An average of 44 unique drivers use the station per month, amounting to a total of 4,200 sessions.
An estimated estimate of 30 tons of greenhouse gases were reduced because of the pilot.
Annual operating costs included about 5,800 for electricity, including peak charges, 2,200 in vendor and warranty fees, and about 12,000 in staff time.
